name: Naga, Integral
body:
NAGA, INTEGRAL
CR 9

XP 6,400
LN Large aberration (psionic)
Init +8; Senses darkvision 60 ft.; Perception +19

DEFENSE

AC 24, touch 13, flat-footed 20 (+4 Dex, +11 natural, –1 size)
hp 115 (11d8+66)
Fort +9, Ref +7, Will +12

OFFENSE

Speed 40 ft.
Melee bite +10 (2d6+6 plus binding jaws)
Space 10 ft.; Reach 5 ft.
Special Attacks binding jaws
Vitalist Powers Known (ML 7th; power points: 63; DC 15 + power level; concentration +12)

Talents-detect psionics, hinder
1st-biofeedback
2nd-animal affinity
3rd-expose weakness, mend body
4th-empathic feedback, psychic reformation

STATISTICS

Str 18, Dex 19, Con 22, Int 14, Wis 21, Cha 19
Base Atk +8; CMB +13; CMD 27 (cannot be tripped)
Feats Combat Reflexes, Expanded Knowledge, Improved Initiative, Overchannel, Psionic Meditation, Quicken Power, Unwilling Participant (DC 20)
Skills Heal +19, Knowledge (history) +16, Knowledge (religion) +16, Perception +19, Sense Motive +19, Spellcraft +16
Languages Aklo, Common, Draconic, telepathy (within collective)
SQ collective (5), telepathy, unified spirit

SPECIAL ABILITIES

Binding Jaws (Su)

When an integral naga hits a creature with its bite attack, it may use its Unwilling Participant feat to induct the creature into its collective as a free action.

Powers

An integral naga manifests powers as a 7th-level vitalist.

Unified Spirit (Su)

An integral naga possesses the collective, telepathy, and spirit of many class feature of a 7th-level vitalist and treats all of its powers known as if they had the network descriptor, The skin of this serpentine creature seems dilated to the point of bursting, as if the body struggles to contain the tremendous volume of thoughts coursing through. As generations of psionic potential build up within the integral naga’s body, the reincarnated being adapts by connecting its mind to other creatures and sharing its raw psionic gifts with them. When no allies exist to foment such exchange, the integral can make psionic connections through their psionic bite.
